entities.name: Amadeus II, Count of Savoy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amadeus II was the count of Savoy from 1078 to 1080. His life is obscure, and few documents mention him. During his rule, he was overshadowed by his mother, but he had good relations with the papacy and, for a time, the Holy Roman emperor.
